header: IP address entity page in Microsoft Defender
content:
Defender
Article • 05/29/2024 •
Applies to: Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel in the Microsoft Defender portal
The IP address entity page in the Microsoft Defender portal helps you examine possible
communication between your devices and external internet protocol (IP) addresses.
Identifying all devices in the organization that communicated with a suspected or
known malicious IP address, such as Command and Control (C2) servers, helps
determine the potential scope of breach, associated files, and infected devices.
You can find information from the following sections in the IP address entity page:
Overview
Incidents and alerts
Observed in organization
Sentinel events
In the left pane, the Overview page provides a summary of IP details (if available).
